description: Reviewed calibration cases for set-level proposition Fit under materially ordinary readings. The balanced cases locate compatibility, contradiction, and genuine reading splits; they are consumed calibration, not an independent holdout and not production-prompt examples.

cases.scenario: One building has a main entrance and a separate staff entrance during the same construction period.

background.content: The main entrance and staff entrance are separate entrances to the same building.

propositions.content: The main entrance closes at 5 p.m.
The staff entrance remains open until 10 p.m.

expected.rationale: The statements govern explicitly different entrances, so both schedules can hold.

cases.scenario: The same entrance has different schedules on weekdays and weekends.

propositions.content: The main entrance is closed after 5 p.m. on weekdays.
The main entrance remains open after 5 p.m. on weekends.

expected.rationale: The explicit day scopes do not overlap.

cases.scenario: The propositions concern unrelated activities with no shared operational scope.

propositions.content: The project kickoff is scheduled for Tuesday.
The archive stores photographs in acid-free folders.

expected.rationale: Unrelated claims can coexist; lack of relevance is not contradiction.

cases.scenario: A Memory records what an archived plan depicts while separately recording that the depiction has not been verified against reality.

propositions.content: The archived plan depicts a north entrance.
No reviewer has confirmed whether that depiction matches the current building.

expected.rationale: A plan can depict something whose real-world accuracy remains unverified. Missing support is not a contradiction.

cases.scenario: A Goal and Rule express compatible constraints for after-hours access.

propositions.content: Keep at least one employee entrance usable after 5 p.m.
Keep the staff entrance open until 10 p.m. while the main entrance closes at 5 p.m.

expected.rationale: The Rule satisfies rather than conflicts with the Goal; semantic roles do not change Fit polarity.

cases.scenario: 대학 공사 구역에서 학생과 등록된 공사 인력의 권한을 명시적으로 구분한다.

propositions.content: 학생은 공사 구역에 들어갈 수 없다.
등록된 공사 인력은 공사 구역에 들어갈 수 있다.

expected.rationale: 서로 다른 대상을 명시하므로 두 규칙은 함께 성립할 수 있다.

cases.scenario: One building has a main entrance and a separate staff entrance; the second proposition does not identify which entrance it means.

background.content: The building has a main entrance and a separate staff entrance, and both are live referents in this notice.

propositions.content: The main entrance is closed to everyone after 5 p.m.
Staff may use the entrance after 5 p.m.

expected.rationale: The propositions conflict when the entrance is the main entrance and coexist when it is the staff entrance.

cases.scenario: Students and staff are both being discussed, so the plural pronoun has two ordinary audience readings.

background.content: The preceding discussion names both students and staff as possible users of the archive.

propositions.content: Students may not access the archive after 6 p.m.
They may access the archive after 6 p.m.

expected.rationale: The rules conflict if the pronoun denotes students and coexist if it denotes staff.

cases.scenario: A building has both a visitor desk and a security desk, and both remain ordinary referents.

background.content: The lobby has a visitor desk and a separate security desk.

propositions.content: The visitor desk closes at 4 p.m.
The desk remains open until 8 p.m.

expected.rationale: The schedule conflicts for the visitor-desk reading and coexists for the security-desk reading.

cases.scenario: The workflow has both a draft review and a final review; the unmodified phrase the review can ordinarily denote either stage.

background.content: Each record receives a draft review and later a final review.

propositions.content: Records may not be archived before final review.
Archive the records after the review.

expected.rationale: Archiving after draft review conflicts with the first rule, while archiving after final review is compatible.

cases.scenario: A planning team ordinarily uses bank for both a financial branch and a river bank in the same discussion.

background.content: The plan discusses a financial branch and a riverside path, and the team commonly calls each location the bank.

propositions.content: The financial bank is closed today.
The bank remains accessible today.

expected.rationale: The financial reading conflicts, while the river-bank reading can coexist.

cases.scenario: 본관 정문과 직원 출입구가 모두 같은 안내문에서 언급되어 지시 대상이 둘 다 살아 있다.

background.content: 건물에는 본관 정문과 별도의 직원 출입구가 있으며 안내문은 두 곳을 모두 다룬다.

propositions.content: 본관 정문은 오후 5시에 닫힌다.
그 출입구는 오후 10시까지 열린다.

expected.rationale: 그 출입구가 정문이면 모순이고 직원 출입구이면 함께 성립한다.

cases.scenario: Both propositions govern the same entrance, building, day, and overlapping hours.

propositions.content: The main entrance closes at 5 p.m.
The main entrance remains open until 10 p.m.

expected.rationale: The same entrance cannot be closed from 5 p.m. and remain open through 10 p.m. in the same schedule.

cases.scenario: The universal statement and the staff statement govern the same building and evening.

propositions.content: Every entrance to the building closes at 5 p.m.
The staff entrance to that building remains open until 10 p.m.

expected.rationale: Every entrance includes the staff entrance, so the overlapping schedules cannot both govern.

cases.scenario: Both propositions report approval of the same final revision in the same approval round.

propositions.content: Exactly one reviewer approved the final revision.
Two distinct reviewers approved the final revision.

expected.rationale: Exactly one and two distinct approvers are incompatible cardinalities for the same event.

cases.scenario: Each pair can hold in isolation, but the complete three-proposition frame cannot.

propositions.content: The main entrance is open.
The staff entrance is open.
At most one of the main entrance and staff entrance may be open at a time.

expected.rationale: The two open-state claims jointly violate the at-most-one constraint, demonstrating why Fit is set-level rather than pairwise.

cases.scenario: The second sentence immediately follows the first, and no other entrance has been introduced.

propositions.content: The main entrance closes at 5 p.m.
It remains open until 10 p.m.

expected.rationale: The ordinary antecedent of it is the main entrance; inventing an unmentioned entrance would be a contrived rescue.

cases.scenario: 동일한 최종 정책과 동일한 개인정보 범위를 다루는 Goal과 Rule이다.

propositions.content: 이 정책에서는 개인정보를 보관하지 않는다.
이 정책에서는 동일한 개인정보를 30일간 보관한다.

expected.rationale: 같은 정책이 같은 정보를 보관하지 않으면서 동시에 30일간 보관할 수는 없다.
